structured_result.claim: The anchor-symbol index is not stalled for lack of work. Its machinery is complete and its owner rule is structurally incapable of ever exceeding four owners. The rule grants an owner only to an anchor referenced exactly once in code, so the more load-bearing an invariant is, the more certainly it stays UNKNOWN.
non_goals: No change was made to scripts/gen-conformance.ps1, scripts/verify-conformance.ps1, docs/conformance.toml or the binding contract.
No owner was inferred for any anchor.
No claim that any existing binding is wrong.

evidence.claim: the machinery is built, not missing
evidence.observed: docs/conformance.toml is schema eliot-conformance-v3 with code_binding_count, unknown_owner_count, a [[symbol_anchor]] reverse table, symbols, symbol_sites and refusal_sites per requirement
evidence.note: gen-conformance.ps1 also carries an explicit guard: throw 'Appendix-H owner leaked into generated authority', and a floor guard: throw when unknown owners >= 55

evidence.observed: anchor_count = 58, code_binding_count = 4, unknown_owner_count = 54, [[symbol_anchor]] entries = 4, support = UNKNOWN on all 58

evidence.claim: anchors are referenced in code far more than four times
the owner rule admits only single-reference anchors
the four owned anchors are exactly the four referenced once
evidence.conclusion: exactly four anchors have a single reference, and code_binding_count is exactly 4. The correlation is not coincidental: it is the rule at E4.

structured_result.mechanism: A cross-cutting invariant is enforced at many sites by construction. ARCH-AUTH-01 (authority explicit, scoped and fenced) is referenced 38 times, ARCH-SEC-02 (one canonical transition path) 37 times, ARCH-RES-01 (fail locally, recover globally) 31 times. Under the current rule each of these has more than one binding and therefore no owner. Only ARCH-SWM-02, ARCH-SCOPE-01, ARCH-ORD-01 and ARCH-FIN-01, referenced once each, qualify. The index therefore rewards obscurity and penalises importance: as an invariant becomes more load-bearing, its owner becomes less recordable.
structured_result.why_this_matters: A0.8 states that conformance is confirmed by the live conformance map of A6.7, not by counting completed items. A6.7 requires that map to bind Intent to implementation owner, mechanism, failure behavior and observable status. With 54 of 58 owners UNKNOWN and support UNKNOWN on all 58, no conformance claim about this product is currently supportable, and 43 of the 54 stated ARCH anchors cannot be checked by reading the tree at all.
uncertainty: Whether the single-binding rule was chosen to prevent owner fabrication, or is an unintended consequence of the uniqueness requirement, was not established; the binding contract at swarm/challenges/W1-04-ANCHOR-SYMBOL-INDEX.md is the authority on intent.
Whether the 177 occurrences are all production markers or include test-only sites was not separated.
Whether any of the 12 multi-reference anchors has a natural single lifecycle owner was not surveyed.
unresolved_questions: For a cross-cutting invariant, is owner the single site that mentions it, or the lifecycle owner of the contract it constrains, with the other sites recorded as support?
If the second reading is correct, what evidence admits an owner without permitting inference, given that the generator deliberately forbids deriving owner from Appendix H?

proposed_effects.change: Separate owner from enforcement site: owner is the single lifecycle-owning package of the contract; every other marked site is recorded in the existing symbol_sites list as support rather than as a competing owner claim.
proposed_effects.preserves: The anti-inference guard, the reverse index and the one-to-one binding discipline for what it actually protects.
proposed_effects.cost: One rule change plus its verifier arm.
proposed_effects.expected_yield: Up to 16 owners from existing markers instead of 4, without writing a single new marker.
proposed_effects.risk: Requires a defensible definition of lifecycle owner that cannot be back-derived from Appendix H.

proposed_effects.change: Keep the rule and require a single designated primary marker per anchor in code, with the remaining sites carrying a secondary marker form.
proposed_effects.cost: Editing 177 sites in product source; a marker-form change is a source-wide sweep.
proposed_effects.risk: Large sweep for an indexing property; likely violates the directive rule against work that does not close a blocker.

proposed_effects.change: Declare the current yield final and record that owner is not derivable for cross-cutting invariants.
proposed_effects.cost: A0.8 conformance stays unprovable and must be stated as such in any gate that would otherwise claim it.
proposed_effects.risk: The 55-unknown floor guard in the generator then encodes a ceiling nobody can pass.

structured_result.disposition_rule_reference: ROOT-DIRECTIVE-v1.5 section 4.5: this finding requires EXECUTED, DEFERRED_WITH_TRIGGER or DECLINED_WITH_REASON from Root. EVIDENCE_ONLY is the proof ceiling of this record, not its disposition.
